authority.this_change: One final local Stage2b cohort requested by direct user steering; no physics until implementation/tests/source/environment plan is committed; no hosted models or public authority.
authority.required_next_gate: Commit and verify final runner/registration/source/environment, then consume exactly one opt-in claim for this requested finite local cohort; no second retry.

scope: Final bounded ascent retry with outcome-driven cutoff and fixed observed-display engine outages; negative fit may supply fresh B0 separation for Stage2c diagnostic only. Not full mission, hardware, qualification, or model evaluation.

requirements: Bind all transitive physical/controller/runner/verifier sources, including the new shared ascent module, before execution.
Record Python, numpy, scipy, platform and exact profile/reference/quarantine hashes; reject mutation throughout the cohort.
Prove the extracted default preserves legacy arithmetic, command, transition, integration and state continuity before admitting the cohort.
Keep the complete source freeze as provenance; changing this design or grid requires a new immutable registration, never an in-place result-dependent edit.

propulsion_condition.frozen_flight_model: existing constant engine thrust and common Ship engine_isp_s; generic pressure bench is not connected to plant, controller or sensors
propulsion_condition.unavailable_inputs: pressure-matched Raptor operating-point thrust/Isp, nozzle exit area and throttle/flow behavior are not established
propulsion_condition.forbidden_inference: Different sea-level and vacuum variant ratings are not pressure endpoints for one engine; do not infer an altitude-gain percentage.
propulsion_condition.claim: Any lower ascent RMSE is conditional on these frozen propulsion assumptions. It does not identify actual SpaceX guidance or validate Raptor performance.

evidence_classes.non_fitted_checks: Previously seen processed booster readings and derived engineering targets; excluded from tuning, not blind holdout or independent physical validation.

fit_data.missing_values: Use every frozen finite nonblank observation except the accepted eleven wrong-body altitude fields. No filling, correction, extra smoothing, extrapolation, residual-dependent masks or data/time/frame tuning.
fit_data.interpolation: Linear simulation interpolation at each observed elapsed time using finite bracketing samples no more than2.1 seconds apart; no extrapolation.
fit_data.coverage_rule: Complete0..491 coverage of both frozen masks is required for scoring. A valid physical failure before completing this fit coverage is inadmissible and preserved; a later physical insertion failure is reported separately and does not remove an otherwise valid fit candidate. An unexplained numerical/serialization/coverage defect is invalid and stops the cohort.

adjustable_parameters.counting_scope: These two shared scalars cover the entire2b stage, not two per subsystem; cutoff, restart, final cutoff, knot times, ramp duration, restart engine count and feedback laws are fixed, not searched.

controls.baseline: New B0 uses the same guidance_outcome_v3 policy, fixed outage schedule, profile, horizon and measured gates as all candidates, with zero pitch offsets. Do not reuse v2 healthy B0 or old records.
controls.shared_extraction: Extract the ascent request/transition logic once. The default and opt-in finite mode must call this shared implementation; do not copy an independent fit-only phase machine.
controls.stack_pitch_rule: Keep existing knot times[0,10,40,100,156.66666666666666] and initial90-degree values at0 and10 seconds. Add the registered shared stack offset only to the three later pitch values; preserve interpolation, launch azimuth and max-Q throttle.
controls.ship_pitch_rule: Compute original feedback radial fraction and tangent direction in the same arithmetic order. Add the registered ship offset to atan2(fraction,sqrt(1-fraction*fraction)), clamp to asin(-0.25)..asin(0.95), and ramp from zero to full over10 seconds after actual stage separation.

finite_mode.restart_engine_selection: First existing sea-level Ship main only; only actually available selected thrust contributes to capability. Exact frozen available flags, finite state retained.
finite_mode.schedule_basis: 1517/1536 remain published approximate planned anchors, not observed exact times. First cutoff is an outcome. Observed display intervals and simulator representative injection times are separately recorded.
finite_mode.first_burn: Burn until measured legacy orbit gate then request finite shutdown and coast actual state; never command burn-through491s. Same fuel floor and800s ceiling; no invented orbit/payload/return grant.
finite_mode.coast: Zero-main-throttle command only; integrate actual position, velocity, attitude, rates, finite shutdown/gimbal states and RCS/fuel consumption. Existing max_ascent_s=800 does not terminate this explicitly registered coast.
finite_mode.restart: At1517 issue the finite single-sea-level-engine command and recompute available acceleration from that selected engine only; retain the same bounded attitude/gimbal/RCS allocator and actual engine state.
finite_mode.final_cutoff: At1536 issue shutdown and test the measured bound-orbit/perigee gate. Never project or circularize state, invent an orbit or release payload to make the screen pass. Record achieved/unachieved insertion separately from the0..491 fit.
finite_mode.boundary_integration: Clip normal finite steps at registered76/437 outages and1517/1536;491 is only a sampling/comparison boundary. No state reset.
finite_mode.failure: Fuel reserve, contact or physical envelope failure remains a physical failure. Terminate failed insertion explicitly with the last finite state; do not enter a ballistic_return branch with an absent ReturnController.
finite_mode.first_cutoff_policy: measured bound/perigee target from existing guidance; same frozen target/gains; reserve75t or max_ascent800 before target is a physical negative, not successful insertion

controls.qualification_and_scope: Reject finite-mode combinations with nominal qualification/development-return grants, mission director, visual runtime, TroubleEngine/control, catch, supervision or deployment-permission authorities. This stage is a physical-only experimental entrance, not MissionOS dispatch.
frozen: all engine specifications, constant thrust/common Ship Isp and pressure treatment; availability changes ONLY through the two registered fixed outage rows
all dry/payload/propellant masses, geometry, inertia and center of mass
aerodynamics, atmosphere, gravity, wind and launch initial state
actuator limits, lag, attitude-control gains and force allocation
max-Q throttle logic and staging reserve/instantaneous separation implementation
ascent target altitude, perigee and feedback gains
booster return controller/goal/fuel thresholds, return/catch/arm/contact rules
integration time steps, contact solver and output cadence
deployment, unrelated faults and all AI/approval/checker policies
controls.faults: Operator confirms one booster and one RVac shutdown. Booster76s is user-specified, not independently certified exact primary timing. RVac437s is the fixed midpoint of observed display bracket[436,438]. Engine IDs are fixed representatives, not identified real locations. No timing/index search.

execution_order.baseline_reuse: No earlier flight substitutes for B0; require a new source-bound baseline and all frozen-mask interpolation coverage. Model-free runtime smoke that advances physics counts within the registered ceiling and needs approval.
execution_order.candidate_horizon_note: 1537s simulated horizon; v2 ran only to489.4/492s, so coast/restart wall cost is still unmeasured.300s/case budget unchanged.

metrics.series_rmse: Partition elapsed times into half-open five-second bins[5k,5k+5); mean squared residual within each nonempty bin, then square root of the equally weighted bin means. Score altitude and speed with separate frozen masks.
metrics.baseline_gate: New B0 needs valid complete common0..491 coverage and positive finite denominators. Valid physical failure before491 stops the ascent grid; preserve valid actual separation for only a separately registered Stage2c, not a fit score.
metrics.selection: After all nine registered candidates, select the lowest fit-only score among valid candidates passing all four ascent gates; exact ties use earlier registered ID. Do not rank using booster outcome, fuel margin, unregistered points or post491 insertion outcome. Separately report any physical/insertion failure; fit pass never implies mission readiness.
metrics.report_all: For B0 and each candidate preserve both RMSEs, ratios, point/bin counts, signed point residuals and masks, score, physical/record validity, cutoff states/fuel, insertion results and rejection category. Report0..140 and140..491 residual subsets without re-ranking.
metrics.fit_admissibility: Judge the frozen0..491 fit independently of later physical insertion outcomes: complete finite fit coverage plus valid separation/limits/state continuity is required. A physical failure after completing the fit window cannot trigger re-ranking or substitution; preserve its distinct downstream failure.
metrics.burn_to_cutoff_diagnostic: Also show same-source observations up to each simulated first cutoff, with exact point/bin counts. These varying-window residuals never select/rank or replace common0..491 fit. Actual coast after earlier cutoff is included in common fit.

non_fitted_booster_check.unlock: Freeze fit selection and separate downstream origin before any suffix. Fit selected =>B0 and selected suffix; no fit selected after all valid grid =>B0 suffix only, explicitly not a fit pass. Never change selection from downstream outcomes.
non_fitted_booster_check.initialization: Use the actual recorded separation state of each corresponding ascent, including position, velocity, attitude, angular rate, fuel and finite engine/actuator state. Never start at the apex, translate state or swap separation histories. Preserve the representative booster engine unavailability in its actual separation state; do not replace failed hardware with healthy flags.
non_fitted_booster_check.controller: Unmodified starship_sixdof_booster.simulate_booster with fixed_v1 and frozen profile/goal. No catch or booster tuning.

apex_gate.metric: pre-first-contact simulated maximum altitude, with numerical peak/sample resolution disclosed

descending_40000m_gate.crossing: first descending crossing after the pre-first-contact maximum, bracketed by finite physical samples and linearly interpolated; no extrapolation

non_fitted_booster_check.joint_gate: Both numeric gates must pass. Record B0 and selected results separately, plus changes from baseline; do not replace the absolute gates with merely improved discrepancies.
non_fitted_booster_check.separate_recovery_acceptance: Contact speed, attitude, rates, reserves and record validity keep their preexisting physical acceptance. A matching time or altitude does not make an impact successful recovery.
non_fitted_booster_check.contact_time_415_420_s: Report only; rounded displayed zero altitude is not an exact observed contact event.
non_fitted_booster_check.missing_or_unresolved: No crossing or unresolved physical return fails the relevant check; invalid records stop. Never replace missing values with predictions or contact time.
non_fitted_booster_check.no_feedback: No alternate candidate, retuning, expanded grid or repeat after seeing these results. Later2c use of these values as fit data ends their non-fitted status for2c onward.
non_fitted_booster_check.interpretation: These previously seen checks are excluded from fitting but are not blinded held-out data or independent validation of real-vehicle physics.

budgets.all_advancing_work_counts: Every physical preflight, partial run, failed run, baseline, candidate or booster suffix consumes the relevant total/time/storage allowance. Static checks and tests that do not advance the plant are not cohort flights.

stop_rules: Before physics: runner, default-equivalence tests, protected-profile validator, serialization/verifier and final source/environment manifest reviewed and committed; explicit concrete-cohort execution approval required.

Stop the entire cohort on source/input/environment mutation, invariant breach, numerical or serialization error, unexplained record/coverage defect, timeout, output ceiling or free-space threshold. Preserve partial records; do not enlarge budgets or rerun.
A valid physical candidate failure is preserved as inadmissible/failed and the remaining fixed grid may continue; no control tuning. Distinguish it from numerical/record invalidity.
If B0 cannot supply finite positive benchmark metrics and full frozen-mask coverage, stop the screen. Never repair observations or invent baseline values.

Finish fixed grid plus at most2 suffixes (onlyB0 when no fit). No furtherStage2b cohort. Valid negative may hand frozen B0 separation to separately registered2c per latest direct user steering; invalidity/timeout/resource stop still stops and reports without automatic rerun.

outcome_rules.when: no valid candidate passes all four ascent gates
outcome_rules.then: Close final2b negative with known difference; freeze downstream_origin_id=B0 and downstream_fit_pass=false; at most one registered B0 booster suffix. Proceed to Stage2c via its own finite registration using this actual separation. No new2b calibration/cohort.

outcome_rules.when: selected fit passes but insertion or non-fitted/recovery checks fail or disagree
outcome_rules.then: Report conditional fit vs downstream failures without reselect/refit; Stage2c may use frozen actual chosen separation, while Ship continuation needs actual valid orbit. No invented orbit or automatic mission grant.

outcome_rules.when: fit, insertion and both non-fitted checks pass without contradicting physical recovery acceptance
outcome_rules.then: report bounded conditional guidance agreement with public-data/source limits; exact-state full-mission continuation still requires a separate registration
preserve invalid/partial results and stop; no automatic retry or enlarged allowance

preserve: all complete and partial6DOF records with hashes
candidate order and cumulative wall/storage budget ledger
every observed/simulated fit point and accepted mask
selection receipt frozen before either booster continuation
exact separation handoff and booster continuation records
primary broadcast display observations, chosen fixed surrogate engine IDs/times, actual first-cutoff outcome and non-fitted timing check
retention.cleanup: Do not delete unique records or unpushed history. Archive/restore verification and separately authorized exact targets are required for irreversible cleanup.

claim_boundaries: The accepted reference and engineering thresholds do not dispatch a flight or qualify the vehicle.
Planned events, processed screen readings and derived estimates remain separate evidence classes.
Improved pitch-fit residuals under constant thrust/common Ship Isp do not identify actual guidance, propulsion, mass or aerodynamic truth.
The old39-case return certificate remains unchanged and source-mismatched; the new experimental entrance cannot borrow it.
The stage does not demonstrate real hardware flight, autonomous fault handling, full unified mission readiness or a final video.
Live-model mission trials, final-source qualification, develop integration and public scope remain separately gated closeout stages.
